sources.label: Native PowerSync and Jazz attachments (one run each)

scope: Each component retains its complete raw manifest, samples, annotations, profiles and provenance. Coverage selects one source per client/case. Native feature exclusions control presentation without rewriting old attempts. The six repaired cases and two native attachment cases each use one predeclared run (n=1). Replaced and development samples are never pooled; unchanged historical selections remain separate.
